protocol.name: new_v1_family_same_user_electrode_shift_extension_v1
protocol.source_fit: For each subject separately, fit F0v2 Rest thresholds, all new-v1 family metadata, StandardScaler and balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924 on that subject's training domain only.
protocol.aggregation: Mean of at most eight 40-sample windows within each native trial; preserve frozen parent trial identities and held wearing domains.
protocol.selection: Maximize pooled validation-subject macro-F1, tie break by lower validation log loss; subjects 18-20 never select an arm and have been inspected in earlier project runs.
protocol.scope: Independent eight-channel 200 Hz public-device same-user wearing-domain screen; not cross-user transfer, calendar-day session transfer or own-device 250 Hz live recognition.
